comparison.objective: Load a housing into a rollover fixture, retain it, invert and lock it, then fit a wear pad; candidate extracts a terminal from a connector housing.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests cradle loading, sliding-bar retention, fixture inversion, bolt insertion, and pad placement. Candidate tests narrow extraction-tool insertion, tang depression, and bimanual pull sequencing.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires ordered retention before inversion, bolt engagement, pad seating, hands clear, and 1 s stability. Candidate requires selective terminal removal with neighbors retained and no connector damage.
comparison.reason: The common word housing does not imply overlap; fixture-based assembly and inversion test different abilities from connector depinning.
